blocks.text: The retry budget of component Q001 is 13 records. It is documented here because several teams depend on it. Changes take effect after the next rolling restart.
The pool size of component X002 is 94 requests. The setting is validated before the service accepts traffic. Changes take effect after the next rolling restart.
The batch limit of component Z003 is 5 attempts. Changes take effect after the next rolling restart. Operators usually leave it unchanged unless the workload grows.
The pool size of component W004 is 74 attempts. This value is read once at startup and can be overridden per environment. Changes take effect after the next rolling restart.
